sourceQuotes.literal: The Yuanyou-era Calendar for Observing Heaven.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: The Yuanyou Calendar for Observing Heaven

sourceQuotes.zh: 演紀上元甲子，距元祐七年壬申，歲積五百九十四萬四千八百八算。
sourceQuotes.literal: The era computation from upper origin jiazi to the seventh year of Yuanyou, renshen, yields an accumulated year count of 5,944,808 counts.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: From upper origin jiazi to the seventh year of Yuanyou (renzhen), the accumulated count is 5,944,808 years.

sourceQuotes.zh: 黃道過宮太史局吳澤等補治有此一段，開封進士吳時舉、國學進士程憙、常州百姓張文進本並無之。
sourceQuotes.literal: For the sun's ecliptic lodge passage, Wu Ze and others of the Astronomical Bureau supplemented and corrected this section; the Kaifeng presented scholar Wu Shiju, the National University presented scholar Cheng Xi, and the Changzhou commoner Zhang Wenjin versions all lack it.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: The ecliptic lodge-passage section was supplemented and corrected by Wu Ze and others of the Astronomical Bureau; the versions of Wu Shiju, Presented Scholar of Kaifeng, Cheng Xi, Presented Scholar of the National University, and Zhang Wenjin, commoner of Changzhou, all lack it.
